newsitem.title: SPAIN: Argentaria cuts prime 50 b.p. to 8.25 pct.
newsitem.headline: Argentaria cuts prime 50 b.p. to 8.25 pct.

text.p: Spain's Grupo Argentaria said on Monday that it was cutting its prime rate 50 basis points to 8.25 percent from 8.75 percent effective today.

In addition, it said it was lowering fixed-rate mortgages to nine percent from 9.9 percent, one-year variable rate mortgages to 6.75 percent from 7.25 percent and six-month variable rate mortgages by 50 basis points to 5.50 percent.
Customer loan rates also were reduced, to 11 percent from 11.50 percent.
